column_description: TEXT. Primary key linking to recipient demographics for immunological data. PK = Recipients_Immunology(Immu_Recip_Registry), FK to Recipients_Demographics.
REAL. Panel reactive antibody score indicating sensitization level. Example: 6.
TEXT. Donor-specific antibody presence status. Possible values: Negative, Positive.
TEXT. Crossmatch test result for donor-recipient compatibility. Possible values: Negative, Pending, Positive.
TEXT. Recipient's cytomegalovirus infection status. Possible values: Negative, Positive.
TEXT. Recipient's Epstein-Barr virus infection status. Possible values: Negative, Positive.
TEXT. Recipient's functional status assessment. Possible values: Mild Impairment, Moderate Impairment, Normal, Severe Impairment.
TEXT. Life support requirements and status. **NULL means life support status is not applicable or not documented.**. Possible values: ECMO, Mechanical Ventilation, VAD.

JSONB column. Stores complete HLA typing profile including A, B, DR, and DQ values for immunological compatibility matching.
